newsitem.title: UK: Active Imaging agrees bid from TVX.
newsitem.headline: Active Imaging agrees bid from TVX.

text.p: Britain's Active Imaging Plc said on Tuesday that TVX Inc, a subsidiary of CommNet Cellular Inc, has made a recommended share offer for the company which values each share at a minimum 104p.

The share offer values Active Imaging's ordinary share capital at around 19.1 million stg. There is also a cash alternative of around 104p per share up with maximum cash available for this of 7.9 million dollars.

Colorado-based TVX, which develops and markets products for the management of digital video and images, has irreovacble undertakings to accept the offer from holders of 77.5 percent of Active Imaging's ordinary shareholders.

"TVX's technolgy is complementary to that of Active Imaging. The combination of the two companies will provide more product offering and a greater distribution strength," said John Osborne, chief executive of Active Imaging.
Active said that the ordinary offer represents a premium of not less than 34 percent over its share price on February 3. By 1016 GMT, shares in the company had jumped 22p to stand at 99-1/2p.
The company also announced that its pretax loss for the year to December 31, 1996 had increased to 3.6 million stg from 552,000.
